title: The High Study
shortDescription: Moonlight and lamplight share a high oak room that does not hurry its guests.
longDescription:
The High Study sits above the Great Hall like a held breath. Oak beams take the moonlight from a round window. A carved owl dais faces six small School banners. Ledgers wait in stacks. A tuning fork lies on the blotter, still as a threat.
Headmaster Alder does not smile first. The room smells of ink, dust, and old feathers.

fixtures.name: Headmaster Alder
fixtures.lookDescription: An ancient snowy owl in a patched green robe, one yellow eye fierce, a scar across the other, a tuning fork at his belt. Try talk alder.
fixtures.examineDescription: Alder's facial disc is white as a judge's ruff. The scar is old. The robe is mended at the elbows. He listens to the end of a sentence, and the questions in his pocket are not all gentle.
fixtures.dialogue: "The Collegium trains woodland students. Choose a School. The bell below can wait until you are ready to stand with others."

welcome.text: "I am Alder. You will not find a house here. You will find a School. Ember, Thorns, the Veil, Stars, Stone, and Steel. Each is a craft. Pick one. The hearths open when you have chosen. The thing that tolls beneath us is not a lesson for the unschooled."

chosen-ember.text: "Ember. Fire that is held, not spilled. Your hearth is not open yet. Down returns you to the Great Hall. Do not waste the hours."

chosen-thorn.text: "Thorns. Growth that knows how to guard itself. Your hearth is not open yet. Down returns you to the Great Hall. Do not waste the hours."

chosen-veil.text: "The Veil. What is unseen still acts. Your hearth is not open yet. Down returns you to the Great Hall. Do not waste the hours."

chosen-stars.text: "Stars. Light that names a path. Your hearth is not open yet. Down returns you to the Great Hall. Do not waste the hours."

chosen-stone.text: "Stone. Patience that does not yield. Your hearth is not open yet. Down returns you to the Great Hall. Do not waste the hours."

chosen-steel.text: "Steel. A blade kept flat until it is needed. Your hearth is not open yet. Down returns you to the Great Hall. Do not waste the hours."

already-chosen.text: "You have a School. The hearths will call you when first lessons are ready. The bell can wait until you can stand with others. Down, if you must wander."

fixtures.name: School Chart
fixtures.examineDescription: Ember: a sheltered flame. Thorns: a leaf opening through a thorny branch. Veil: a silver moth. Stars: a clear constellation. Stone: a patient arch. Steel: a blade laid flat in an open hand. Beneath all six: Learn well. Use wisely. Leave room for others.
